scope: terminal client contract coverage: configure an agent from the terminal, run a capability self-check, and publish user constraints, closing the create-session -> configure-agents -> verify-endpoint -> steer-the-session loop

agent_configuration.role_mapping: pane 1 -> coordinator, panes 2-4 -> worker; the user cannot pick a role, matching the agent/list pane mapping
agent_configuration.id_generation: empty pane gets uuid::Uuid::new_v4(); an existing agent keeps its id and prefills model/baseUrl/protocol/contextBytes from agent/list
agent_configuration.local_validation: model 1..200 bytes; contextBytes 4096..1000000; baseUrl mirrors core Agent::validate (https, or http on localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1]; no credentials/query/fragment). Host remains authoritative and its errors are surfaced verbatim
agent_configuration.protocol_field: toggle via Left/Right/Space between responses and chat_completions; not free text

connection_check.flow: agent/testConnection queues a real probe task; the client then polls agent/connectionResult every 900ms up to 100 times until the task is completed/failed/cancelled
connection_check.verdict: verified=true only when the task completed and the host observed both the connection_probe_ok result event and a usage event; capabilities = text/stream/function_tools. Anything else is reported as not verified
connection_check.display: pane history gets `[自检] 已排队连接探针任务 <id>` then `[自检] 通过：…` (green) or `[自检] 未通过：…` (yellow); the probe becomes the agent's latest task so the status row tracks it and Ctrl+C can cancel it
connection_check.bound: bounded polling; on timeout it stops and tells the user the probe may still be queued; a host error stops polling immediately

user_constraints.kinds: requirement / user_override / suggestion, toggled with Left/Right/Tab and marked with a filled bullet; the default is requirement
user_constraints.semantics: requirement and user_override are authoritative records the host injects into every model request and which outrank model decisions; suggestion is advisory. The modal states this
user_constraints.content: single line, <= 4096 bytes; spaces are content and never toggle the kind (regression-covered); empty content is rejected locally with a Chinese note
user_constraints.flow: event/publish returns a revision, the client then refreshes event/list so the record appears in the shared panel (F3) as `[用户] …` or `[建议] …`
user_constraints.host_authority: the kind whitelist, length limits and injection timing live in the host; the client only offers legal kinds and does not duplicate the check
user_constraints.irreversible: a published constraint cannot be retracted from the terminal; records are append-only by design and the modal says so

suite.ignored_reason: core runtime_e2e needs installed Codex; tui real-host smoke needs a built codex-collab-core

opt_in.real_host_smoke: passed: session/create, agent/configure, agent/list (carries contextBytes), task/list, approval/list, task/get, task/integrate, context/compact, agent/testConnection, agent/connectionResult, event/publish; non-UUID agent id and out-of-range contextBytes rejected; connectionResult reports verified=false with empty capabilities and rejects non-probe and unknown tasks; event/publish returns an increasing revision and rejects non-user kinds such as decision; unknown approval/task ids and stale compaction revisions fail closed, empty summary rejected

pty_demo_smoke: passed: four panes, paste/send, stop, confirmed quit, terminal restoration, non-TTY rejection
pty_live_smoke: passed: seeded real session+agent via line protocol; Ctrl+A prefilled the seeded coordinator (edit path); Tabbed to a worker pane and added a second agent through the form; Ctrl+T queued a connection probe; Ctrl+U selected suggestion, typed text containing spaces, published, and F3 confirmed `[建议] keep … stable` in the shared records; coding toggle, review/compaction/create routing; masked credential form; confirmed quit and terminal restoration
footer: key hints on two lines (Tab/F2/F3/Ctrl+A, then Ctrl+T/Ctrl+U/Ctrl+E/Ctrl+G/Ctrl+P/Ctrl+N/Ctrl+K/Ctrl+R/Ctrl+C/Ctrl+Q) above the feedback line
pty_render_note: ratatui emits only changed cells, so spaces are absent from the pty byte stream; the live probe matches on non-space runs and record prefixes instead
cost_warning: the connection probe truly calls the model and may incur cost; the feedback line states this explicitly
